verdict.rationale: Teller's homepage describes one account connection that then lets you verify ownership, ACH details, balances, and transactions. An enrollment is modeled as a single bank login covering multiple accounts, and the balances, transactions, and identity APIs all draw on that granted access. Accounts at some institutions need a separate microdeposit flow to get account details, but that is an institution-coverage fallback rather than a per-product connection requirement. Missing for 10: explicit docs stating a single Teller Connect enrollment authorizes all products at once (e.g., how products are selected or scoped at connect time), and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-product use from one session.
